Riley: quick micro-question: best two-word life advice? go! :thinking:
Anya: "Make friends"
Marco: "Nap intelligently" :zzz:
Claire: "Ship Monday" :rocket:
Theo: "Bring snacks" :cookie:
Riley: loving these. also tiny poll — who wants to start a 10-min office walk at 3pm? yes/no/maybe
Anya: yes. my desk chair needs revenge.
Marco: maybe, depends on weather and coffee levels.
Claire: yes + will bring a one-line joke for the route.
LobbyBot: FYI: package delivery at 15:05 for Marco in reception.
Riley: one-liner contest on the walk: winner gets to choose the playlist. entries: "Two words: less hurry." "Two words: pet plants."
Theo: entry: "Two words: actually listen."
Claire: bonus entry: "Two words: free donuts."
Riley: final plan: 3pm short walk, meet by the kitchen, bring one short joke or two-word advice. See you then! :walking:
